rule: Include one current corpus record per ID with at least one saved all-YES Q1/Q2/Q3 human review, an exact-current scientific-content or owner-confirmed continuity binding, no retained adverse Q1/Q2/Q3 judgment, and no unresolved current source-scope flag.
adverse_history: Conservatively retain older and unknown-version adverse judgments; general continuity confirmation does not erase failed checks.
benchmark_exclusions: Exclude adverse human line-set judgments whose reviewed labels match the current gold-label set. Full original source-version identity for those older sheets is not established. Later general approval does not erase the disagreement.
independence: Human-approved means backed by saved human judgments. It does not imply multiple independent human reviewers per item.
sampling_scope: This selected union is distinct from the original random-audit population; the original sampling interval is not an accuracy interval for the selected core.
